stories.title: 'Proud' Murphy lauds Brewers for outlasting Dodgers in Game 1
stories.summary: After failing to score more than one run in any contest of a four-game sweep against the Los Angeles Dodgers last year in the NLCS, the Milwaukee Brewers did just enough in Game 1 this year to extract a 2-1 win Sunday at American Family Field.

stories.title: Backup QB Huntley rewards Ravens' faith in him with clutch effort in OT win
stories.summary: With Lamar Jackson still out, Tyler Huntley backed up the Ravens' faith in him by leading them to a 30-23 overtime win against the Falcons, during which Huntley was 11-for-11 passing for 80 yards on the final two drives.

stories.title: WNBA Finals location for Dream home games still uncertain
stories.summary: The Dream, dealing with conflicting events at State Farm Arena, are still determining where they will play their home games during the upcoming WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Commanders botch last play in OT, resulting in tie; 'It's on me,' Daniels says
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels said of the chaotic final seconds that prevented his team from attempting a winning field goal, "Ultimately, it's on me."

stories.title: Packers let play do talking, then roast Bears' Burden after win: 'He quit'
stories.summary: Zaire Franklin had some strong words for Luther Burden -- even if he didn't mention him by name -- after the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears at Lambeau Field.
